objective_contribution: Preserve token-efficient external evidence identity while separating treatment-added representation from shared inherited history, testing whether ARE improves terminal context selection with fewer model tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can request-local evidence handles preserve exact delivered-evidence selection while adding zero full read IDs, reducing GLM-5.3-flash terminal-review input by at least 128 tokens, and leaving inherited prompt content exactly paired at 8K?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Incremental non-disclosure implementation, Round 51 replay, mutation proof, fresh selection, repositories, scorer, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and reviewed decision.

measurement_mapping.native: Quality uses the fixed eight-identity denominator after handles resolve to exact delivered read IDs.
measurement_mapping.retention: Treatment exposes at most three short handle/path/range records at the held terminal boundary.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Private mappings are receipt-bound; treatment-added state and schema contain zero full IDs; inherited mapped-ID occurrences are exactly paired; unknown and duplicate handles fail closed.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Every model input and output token counts; Round 51 provider calibration and fresh first-request receipts measure savings.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Causal separation of inherited state and added representation applies beyond code, while this run remains GLM code-context evidence.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: Stop immediately on mapping, incremental non-disclosure, token, ancestry, or minimum-pair failure.
